title: reconciliation.json
description: What the deck's own numbers say about each other. Produced by reconcile.py from the ledger, the independent second read, and the model's proposed relations. `relations` holds ONLY what a founder sees — select() decides that, and suppressed relations are reported as counts so nothing downstream can reach past it.

status.description: checked = relations were computed. no_figures = the deck states too few numbers to relate; refused when the deck's own text is full of numerals. gate_failed = the independent read could not corroborate enough of the ledger to trust it. Absence of this artifact means the step did not run, which is a pipeline error and is deliberately distinguishable from all three.

figures_verified.description: Figures whose verbatim quote was found in the independent second read.

second_read_coverage.description: Which figure-bearing slides the independent read actually covered. A figure whose slide is in slides_missing failed the gate because nobody looked, not because the ledger is untrustworthy — two failures the gate alone cannot tell apart, and only one of them is the deck's problem.

attribution.description: Not a gate — a field. quote_carries_label means the label's words appear in the quote; layout_attributed means they do not, and the figure's meaning rests on where it sat on the slide. The weaker of the two bounds a relation's confidence.

suppressed.description: Counts by reason for every computed relation the founder does NOT see. Contents are deliberately absent.

rendered.description: The founder-facing line, with both sides printed in the same number space.

verdict.description: contradiction and derived are the only two that reach a founder. convention_differs, confirmation and restatement are suppressed by select() and appear only in the counts above.
